note: Coordinates are approximate positions for campus navigation. Update with GPS-verified values.

buildings.name: Administrative Block
buildings.description: Central administration, admissions office, examination cell, and registrar.

buildings.name: Institute of Technology (ITNU) - Main Block
buildings.description: Primary engineering block housing CSE, ECE, Electrical, and E&I departments. Includes lecture halls, labs, and faculty offices.

buildings.name: ITNU - Mechanical & Civil Block
buildings.description: Engineering block for Mechanical, Civil, and Chemical Engineering departments with specialized workshops and labs.

buildings.name: Institute of Management (IMNU)
buildings.description: Management institute offering MBA programs. Includes case study rooms, Bloomberg terminal lab, and auditorium.

buildings.name: Institute of Pharmacy (IOP)
buildings.description: Pharmacy institute with research labs, drug formulation center, and herbal garden.

buildings.name: Institute of Science (IOS)
buildings.description: Science institute offering programs in Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics, and Biotechnology.

buildings.name: Institute of Law (IOL)
buildings.description: Law institute with moot court hall, legal aid clinic, and dedicated law library.

buildings.name: Central Library
buildings.description: Multi-floor central library with 100,000+ volumes, digital resource center, silent study zones, and group discussion rooms.

buildings.name: Sports Complex
buildings.description: Multi-sport facility with cricket ground, indoor badminton courts, gym, swimming pool, and athletics track.

buildings.name: University Auditorium
buildings.description: 2000-seat auditorium for convocations, tech fests, cultural events, and guest lectures.

buildings.name: Main Canteen & Food Court
buildings.description: Central food court with multiple vendor stalls, seating for 500+, and hygienic kitchen facilities.

buildings.name: Industry-Institute Interaction Cell (IIIC)
buildings.description: Central placement cell coordinating campus recruitment, internships, and industry partnerships. Contact: iiicell@nirmauni.ac.in

buildings.name: PG Hostel Complex
buildings.description: On-campus hostel for M.Tech, MCA, and PhD students. B.Tech students use nearby off-campus PG accommodations.

buildings.name: Main Parking Area
buildings.description: Open parking with designated areas for two-wheelers, four-wheelers, and university bus bay.

buildings.name: Main Entrance Gate
buildings.description: Primary campus entrance with security checkpoint. Landmark for directions.

navigation_notes: University bus service available from SG Highway and major city points.
Nearest BRTS stop: Nirma University (500m from main gate).
Nearest metro station: Doordarshan Kendra (under construction, ~2km).
Auto-rickshaw and ride-share available at main gate.
